# Leasing Professional

> > Comprehensive commercial lease agreement templates, forms, and strategies for landlords and tenants across office, retail, industrial, and specialized properties.

Leasing Professional provides a curated collection of commercial lease agreements, property management forms, and leasing strategies tailored to different property types and state-specific requirements. The platform serves real estate professionals with ready-to-use templates and negotiation guidance for complex commercial leasing scenarios.

## Key Topics

- Commercial Lease Agreements
- Pro-Tenant Lease Forms
- Pro-Landlord Lease Strategies
- Office-Industrial-Retail Properties
- State-Specific Lease Forms
- Landlord-Tenant Rights
- Work Letters & Tenant Improvements
- Lease Amendments
- Property Management Agreements
- Recapture Rights
- CPI Adjustments
- Parking Rights
- Food Court Leasing
- Retail Shopping Centers
- Healthcare Real Estate

## Core Lease Agreement Templates

- [The Pro-Landlord Office Lease With Expense Stop](https://www.leasingprofessional.com/lease-agreement/401-pro-landlord-office-lease-with-expense-stop.htm): Pro-landlord office lease form with expense stop and CPI adjustment
- [Agreements For Single Tenant Leases](https://www.leasingprofessional.com/lease-agreement/single-tenant-lease-agreement.htm): Single tenant industrial gross lease with right of first offer
- [Lease For Restaurant And Bar Constructed By Tenant On Landlord's Real Estate](https://www.leasingprofessional.com/lease-agreement/1225-lease-for-restaurant-and-bar-constructed-by-tenant-on-landlord-real-estate.htm): Lease form for restaurant/bar with tenant construction rights
- [Lease For 150 Parking Spaces](https://www.leasingprofessional.com/lease-agreement/1351-lease-agreement-for-150-parking-spaces.htm): Lease form template for 150 parking spaces with landlord-tenant terms
- [Nonexclusive Parking Rights Addendum To Office Lease](https://www.leasingprofessional.com/lease-agreement/621-nonexclusive-parking-rights-addendum-to-office-lease.htm): Parking rights addendum form for office leases with nonexclusive terms
- [Lease Amendment Granting The Landlord Warrants As Additional Rent](https://www.leasingprofessional.com/lease-agreement/251-lease-amendment-granting-landlord-warrants-as-additional-rent.htm): Lease amendment form for startup tenant warrant agreements as rent
